acceptance: The owner's decision and the access route (or the evidence that none exists) are recorded.
If run: a cost probe result, then closeout and commit-labels scenarios at 30 per arm with bands, and the loading-map probe for that harness, are reported in a dated results file.

Spend is within the confirmed ceiling.
description: Problem: every decision in the three evaluation rounds rests on Claude models. In the owner's logs the Muse Spark family is the most used in main sessions (about 460 since September) and has never been evaluated; the phase 2 plan notes Muse and Gemini models were not available to the runner. Rules that matter on Claude models may behave differently there, and no skill text may be deleted on Claude-only evidence. Outcome: a recorded decision, and if yes a first measurement of the two phase 2 keep rules and the loading map on a Muse model. Decision gate: ask the owner whether a Muse model can be reached from omp or another supported harness and whether the spend is wanted. If it cannot be reached headlessly, record how that was established and drop the item. If yes, start with a 10-session cost probe; continue only if the projected cost of the two keep-rule scenarios at 30 per arm is under the ceiling. Guardrails: (1) agents under test run only in /tmp/omp-ablation sandboxes through evals/ablation/run.py or the loading-map probe; (2) do not change ~/.omp/agent/config.yml or ~/.omp/agent/rules while sessions run, and start no run while another evaluation is running; (3) write the pre-registration (hypothesis, arms, checks, sample, decision) and commit it before any scored session; smoke runs never count; (4) use a new out folder and a ledger with the ceiling stated here; stop at the ceiling and report, do not raise it without the owner's approval; (5) read at least 5 transcripts per arm before reporting any number, and report grader faults found; (6) delete or weaken no instruction or skill text on this evidence; (7) correct an existing report with a dated note, never by silently rewriting a published number; (8) scenario and scratch code that is part of the result is committed with it; (9) publish by task branch and draft PR with identity Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>. Spend ceiling 100 USD or the equivalent plan quota, confirmed with the owner. Extra: a session answered by any other model is discarded; do not use a subscription quota in a way that blocks the owner's own work (ask for a window); results are reported per model and never pooled with Claude results.
